rationale: Firmus's $2B round funds Project Southgate's Melbourne AI Factory expansion, which deploys ~18,400 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs and is co-designed to NVIDIA's DSX reference architecture (Firmus's own Hypercube cooling/power system built specifically around it) - direct silicon/platform supplier to the capacity being built.

Sandvik partnered directly with Mariana Minerals to deploy its AutoMine Surface Drilling autonomous platform, integrated into MarianaOS at the Copper One mine - a named equipment/technology supplier to the funded buildout.
Same Series B proceeds fund the Copper One autonomous mine where Sandvik's AutoMine Surface Drilling platform is directly integrated into MarianaOS - named equipment/technology supplier.

Aerolloy Technologies (PTC Industries' wholly-owned subsidiary) won a development-and-supply order for large superalloy investment castings (LOX system housings/manifolds) for New Glenn's BE-4 engines - a direct named hardware supplier that benefits as Blue Origin scales production with fresh capital.

Unison Industries, a wholly-owned GE Aerospace subsidiary, holds a long-term agreement to design, manufacture and support ignition systems for the BE-4/BE-7/BE-3U engine family used on New Glenn - a direct supplier, though the contract predates this raise and GE Aerospace is a large diversified aerospace company so this is one small piece of revenue.

Sunrise Energy Metals is itself the direct recipient of the $400M DoW Office of Strategic Capital conditional loan for its Syerston scandium project, and it is a public, tradeable company - the market reacted directly (shares jumped on the announcement).

Lockheed Martin holds an option to purchase up to 25% of Syerston's annual scandium output over five years; the DoW loan de-risks the project that secures this offtake for Lockheed's own aerospace/defense alloy supply chain - an indirect, second-order beneficiary via guaranteed non-China scandium supply.

Panasonic Energy has a supply agreement to procure Sila's Titan Silicon anode material from the same Moses Lake, WA plant this DoW loan helps expand - a direct offtake customer that benefits from de-risked domestic capacity.

Mercedes-Benz was the first automaker to sign a supply agreement for Sila's silicon-anode chemistry (planned for the electric G-Class); it benefits from the expanded, government-backed domestic manufacturing capacity this loan funds.

Magna is a named commercial partner/investor already sampling Niron's rare-earth-free magnets; the conditional DoW loan accelerates the Minnesota plant Magna would source from, reducing its exposure to China-controlled rare-earth magnet supply - though Magna is also an investor in Niron, so the beneficiary read is partly circular.

Moove is already Waymo's third-party fleet operator running robotaxis in Phoenix and Miami (soon London); the new capital scales Moove's robotics-first 'Nests' depot infrastructure that charges/services/orchestrates those fleets, lowering Waymo's (Alphabet's) marginal cost of robotaxi expansion - an indirect platform-owner read, not a direct supplier link.
